Aditi Kapoor  
📍 Tel Aviv, Israel | 📧 aditi.kapoor@cloudnesttech.com | 📞 +972-54-123-4567 | 🌐 linkedin.com/in/aditi-kapoor | 📄 github.com/aditikapoor  

Professional Summary  
A seasoned QA engineer with 11 years of delivering robust test frameworks for global SaaS platforms. Specialized in architecting end-to-end test strategies that align with enterprise security standards and CI/CD pipelines. Proven ability to scale automated test infrastructures across 12+ time zones, reduce regression defect resolution time by 40%, and mentor cross-functional teams in BDD/TDD practices. Currently leading security testing initiatives at CloudNest Technologies, ensuring compliance with ISO 27001 and GDPR frameworks.  

Technical Skills  
- **Go**: Instrumented distributed test orchestration systems for CloudNest’s multi-cloud deployments, enabling parallel execution of 500+ test cases with 98% reliability. Integrated Go-based microservices for real-time test result aggregation in CI/CD pipelines.  
- **Java**: Developed reusable test harnesses for legacy SaaS modules at ABC Corp, reducing manual test cycles by 30% while maintaining 95% code coverage. Leveraged Java for custom reporting tools that integrated with Jira and Confluence.  
- **BDD/TDD**: Spearheaded adoption of Cucumber and JUnit across XYZ Inc’s 15+ product lines, resulting in a 25% reduction in production defects. Mentored 12 engineers in TDD practices, leading to 30% faster issue resolution in dev teams.  
- **Python**: Automated API validation workflows for CloudNest’s RESTful services, ensuring 100% coverage of edge cases in load-balanced environments. Built Python scripts to monitor test execution metrics across 10+ AWS regions.  
- **REST API design**: Architected secure API endpoints for CloudNest’s customer portal, integrating OAuth2.0 and rate-limiting strategies. Redesigned API testing frameworks to support 100,000+ concurrent requests without degradation.  
- **API testing**: Engineered a centralized API testing platform using Postman and JMeter, reducing environment setup time by 50% for QA teams. Integrated automated validation for 200+ API endpoints across 50+ microservices.  
- **Performance testing (JMeter/k6)**: Led performance benchmarks for CloudNest’s SaaS platform, identifying bottlenecks in database queries and network latency. Optimized test scripts to simulate 500,000 users with sub-200ms response times.  
- **Selenium/Playwright**: Built cross-browser test frameworks for CloudNest’s web applications, achieving 99.5% compatibility across Chrome, Firefox, and Safari. Migrated legacy Selenium tests to Playwright for improved parallelization.  
- **Test strategy design**: Defined test scope for CloudNest’s global rollout, aligning with regional compliance requirements. Coordinated with product managers to prioritize test cases based on business impact and risk.  
- **Test automation**: Established a unified test automation framework that reduced redundant test scripts by 60%. Championed shift-left testing practices, integrating QA into sprint planning for 12+ agile teams.
